abstract: The BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) for May 2024 provides comprehensive employment and wage data across U.S. occupations. The data shows a median annual wage of $49,500 across all occupations, with notable wage growth disparities between AI-exposed and non-AI-exposed sectors, where AI-exposed administrative and clerical occupations experienced 1.1% wage growth compared to 3.8% growth in non-AI-exposed occupations.
keyFindings: Median annual wage for all occupations in May 2024 was $49,500
AI-exposed administrative and clerical occupations experienced wage growth of 1.1%
Non-AI-exposed occupations experienced wage growth of 3.8%, substantially outpacing AI-exposed sectors
methodology: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) survey data collected in May 2024, covering national, state, and metropolitan/nonmetropolitan occupational employment and wage profiles. Data available in multiple formats (HTML, XLSX, TXT) with breakdowns by industry and ownership. Historical data available from 1997 forward.
